academic_translation:
Therefore, if you wish to attain the supreme primordial wisdom of a Buddha,
Generate faith in this Mother of the Victors!
For example, it is unfitting to become like a merchant
Who, having gone to an island of jewels, returns with exhausted goods.
translation: So, if you want to reach the highest deep knowing of a Buddha, you must build trust in this Mother of the Victorious Ones! For example, it would be wrong to act like a merchant who travels to an island of jewels but returns with no goods at all.

academic_translation:
The purity of form should be known as the purity of the fruit;
The purity of the fruit and form becomes the purity of omniscience.
The purity of omniscience, the purity of the fruit, and the purity of form
Are equivalent to the element of space, indivisible and not to be cut apart.
translation: You should know that the purity of form is the purity of the fruit. The purity of the fruit and form becomes the purity of knowing everything. The purity of knowing everything, the purity of the fruit, and the purity of form are equal to the element of space. They are not separate and cannot be cut apart.

locked_terms.use: getting old, getting sick, and dying

translation: Chapter three: showing knowing every foundation. Through perfect wisdom, a hero acts anywhere. They go entirely beyond the three realms, but they do not enter freedom. Their mental trouble is gone, but they still show birth. They are free from getting old, getting sick, and dying, but they still show dying.

academic_translation:
These beings are attached to the mud of name and form;
They wander in the wheel of saṃsāra, like a wheel of wind.
Knowing that deluded beings are like deer caught in a snare,
Those endowed with wisdom roam like birds in the sky.
translation: These beings are stuck in the mud of name and form. They wander in the cycle of rebirth like a spinning wheel of wind. Confused beings are like deer caught in a trap. But those with wisdom fly freely like birds in the sky.

academic_translation:
Whoever with completely pure conduct does not engage in form,
And does not engage in consciousness, perception, feeling, and volition,
Practising in that way, they completely abandon all attachment,
And, finding liberation from attachment, they practice the wisdom of the Sugatas.
translation: Whoever acts with pure conduct does not get caught up in form. They do not get caught up in awareness, idea, feeling, and intention. Practicing in this way, they drop all clinging. Finding freedom from clinging, they practice the wisdom of the Well-Gone Ones.

academic_translation:
The wise and luminous bodhisattva practising in that way,
Having severed attachment, moves among beings without attachment,
Like the sun, freed from the eclipse of Rāhu, shining brightly,
And like a blazing fire that burns grass, wood, and forests.
translation: The wise and bright awakening hero practices in this way. They cut off clinging, and they move among beings without clinging. They are like the sun shining brightly after being freed from an eclipse by Rahu. They are like a blazing fire burning up grass, wood, and forests.

academic_translation:
All phenomena being naturally pure and completely pure,
When the bodhisattva looks through the perfection of wisdom,
They do not apprehend an agent, nor do they apprehend all phenomena;
This is the practice of the supreme perfection of wisdom.
translation: All things are totally pure and pure by nature. When an awakening hero looks through perfect wisdom, they do not find a doer. They also do not find things. This is the highest practice of perfect wisdom.

academic_translation:
Chapter Four: Teaching the complete realization of all aspects.
Śakra, king of the gods, asked the Victor:
"How does a bodhisattva strive in the practice of wisdom?"
"They do not strive even a particle in the aggregates and elements;
Not striving in the aggregates—that is the striving of a bodhisattva."
translation: Chapter Four: Teaching full understanding in every way. Shakra, king of the gods, asked the Victorious One, "How does an awakening hero work hard in the practice of wisdom?" He replied, "They do not work hard at all in the heaps and elements. Not working hard in the heaps is exactly how an awakening hero works hard."

academic_translation:
Whoever, having heard that these phenomena are like emanations and illusions,
Has no doubt and continually applies themself to the training,
That sentient being should be known to have entered the Great Vehicle long ago,
And to have served many tens of billions of Buddhas.
translation: Some living beings hear that these things are like magic creations and illusions. They have no doubt. They keep working at their training. You should know they entered the Great Vehicle long ago. They have already served billions of Buddhas.

academic_translation:
When a person who has set out on a wilderness path of many yojanas
Sees the excellent forests at the cowherds' boundary,
They think, "These are signs that a village or city is near,"
And they find relief, with no fear of robbers.
translation: Imagine a person walking on a wild path for many leagues. Then they see beautiful forests where the cowherds work. They think, "These are signs that a village or city is near." They feel relieved and have no fear of robbers.

academic_translation:
Likewise, when thoroughly seeking awakening, whoever comes to hear
This perfection of wisdom of the Victors
Attains relief and becomes fearless;
They are not on the stage of an arhat, nor the stage of a pratyekabuddha.
translation: It is just like that when you seek awakening. Anyone who hears this perfect wisdom of the Victorious Ones feels relieved. They become fearless. They are not on the level of a worthy one, nor the level of a solitary Buddha.

academic_translation:
When a person traveling to see the water of the ocean
Sees trees, forests, and mountains, it is still far away;
But when they do not see these signs, they think, "The great ocean
Is near," and they have no doubt about it.
translation: Imagine a person traveling to see the ocean. If they still see trees, forests, and mountains, the ocean is far away. But when they no longer see these signs, they think, "The great ocean is near." They have no doubt about it at all.

academic_translation:
Likewise, those fully entered into supreme awakening
Should be known as hearing this perfection of wisdom of the Victors;
Even if they have not received a direct prophecy from the Guide,
They know: "Before long, I will touch the awakening of a Buddha."
translation: Just like that, those who fully enter the highest awakening hear this perfect wisdom of the Victorious Ones. The Guide may not have given them a direct prediction yet. But they still know, "Before long, I will touch a Buddha's awakening."

academic_translation:
In the fine springtime, when leaves have fallen from the trees,
Before long, the branches produce leaves, fruits, and flowers;
Whoever attains this perfection of wisdom in their hands
Will attain the awakening of the Guides before long.
translation: In the beautiful springtime, old leaves fall from the trees. Before long, those branches grow new leaves, fruits, and flowers. It is the same for anyone holding this perfect wisdom in their hands. Before long, they will reach the awakening of the Guides.

academic_translation:
For example, when a pregnant woman is afflicted with pain,
It is said that the time for her to give birth has arrived;
Likewise, when a bodhisattva hears the wisdom of the Victors
And generates joy and aspiration, they will swiftly touch awakening.
translation: Think of a pregnant mother who feels pain. People say her time to give birth has arrived. It is the same when an awakening hero hears the wisdom of the Victorious Ones. If they feel joy and strong hope, they will quickly touch awakening.

academic_translation:
When practicing the supreme perfection of wisdom, a yogin
Does not see the increase or the complete decrease of form;
Whoever does not see phenomena, non-phenomena, or the dharmadhātu,
And does not touch nirvāṇa, that one abides in wisdom.
translation: When practicing the highest perfect wisdom, a meditator does not see form grow or shrink. They do not see things, non-things, or the expanse of all things. They do not even touch peace beyond sorrow. Someone like this truly lives in wisdom.

A person practicing here does not make up ideas about a Buddha's qualities. They do not form ideas about any power, base of magical power, or peaceful awakening. Being without fixed ideas and free from made-up thoughts, they practice through blessing. This is how to practice the highest perfect wisdom.

academic_translation:
Subhūti asked the Buddha, the Moon of Speakers:
"What are the obstacles for those who delight in qualities?"
The Teacher replied, "There will be many obstacles;
Of those, I will fully explain just a few for now."
translation: Subhuti asked the Buddha, the Moon of Speakers. He asked, "What is an obstacle for people who love good qualities?" The Teacher answered, "There will be many obstacles. For now, I will explain just a few of them."

academic_translation:
When writing down this perfection of wisdom of the Victors,
Various different modes of eloquence will arise;
And without having accomplished the benefit of beings, as swiftly as a flash of lightning,
They fall away completely; this is the work of Māra.
translation: When someone writes down this perfect wisdom of the Victorious Ones, many kinds of clever speech will appear. But they will vanish like lightning, without helping beings at all. This is Mara's work.

academic_translation:
When this is explained, some will harbor doubts, thinking:
"Here the Guide has not even fully pronounced my name,
Nor fully pronounced my family, birthplace, or clan."
They will not listen, but abandon it; this is the work of Māra.
translation: When this is explained, some people will have doubts. They will think, "The Guide did not even say my name. He did not talk about my family, birthplace, or clan." They will stop listening and walk away. This is Mara's work.

academic_translation:
Not knowing this, having discarded the root,
In their delusion, they will search for branches and leaves.
It is like finding an elephant and then searching for its footprints;
Having heard the perfection of wisdom, searching for sūtras is exactly like that.
translation: If people do not know this, they throw away the root. In their confusion, they look for branches and leaves instead. This is like finding an elephant and then looking for its footprints. Hearing the perfect wisdom and then searching for other scriptures is exactly like that.

academic_translation:
For example, just as someone who has found food with a hundred flavors,
Having found supreme food, searches for inferior food;
A bodhisattva who, having found this perfection,
Seeks awakening through the stage of an arhat, is exactly like that.
translation: Someone might find the best food with a hundred wonderful flavors. But then they look for bad food instead. An awakening hero might find this perfection. If they then look for awakening through the level of a worthy one, they are exactly like that.

Some people only desire respect and gain. Their minds want to view outside things, so they spend too much time with households. They throw away the teaching and do things against the teaching. They leave the path and walk on a wrong path. This is Mara's work.

academic_translation:
Those who at that time, having become eager and faithful,
Go to listen to this sublime Dharma,
Will, upon knowing that the Dharma preacher is preoccupied with activities,
Depart, devoid of joy and unhappy.
translation: At that time, eager and faithful people will go to listen to this best teaching. But they will see that the speaker of the teaching is too busy with other things. Then they will leave without any joy, feeling unhappy.

academic_translation:
At that time, this work of Māra will arise:
At that time, those by whom many monks are agitated,
So that they do not uphold this perfection of wisdom—
Many other various obstacles will also arise.
translation: At that time, Mara's work will appear. People will upset many monks so they stop holding on to this perfect wisdom. Many other obstacles will also come up.

academic_translation:
Whatever priceless jewels may be found,
They are rare and always subject to much harm.
Likewise, the supreme perfection of wisdom of the Victors,
This precious Dharma is also rare and always subject to much harm.
translation: Priceless jewels are very hard to find. They are rare, and they are always in danger. It is the same with the perfect wisdom of the Victorious Ones. This precious teaching is also rare and always in danger.

academic_translation:
Sentient beings of small intellect who have newly entered the vehicle,
Whoever has not found this rare jewel—
In order to create obstacles for them, Māra will become energetic;
But the Buddhas of the ten directions apply themselves to fully upholding them.
translation: Some living beings have just entered the vehicle. Their understanding is small, and they have not yet found this rare jewel. Mara will work hard to make obstacles for them. But the Buddhas of the ten directions will work hard to protect them.

academic_translation:
When a mother who has many children falls ill,
They all become distressed and attend upon her.
Likewise, the Buddhas of the world systems in the ten directions also
Keep in mind this holy wisdom, who has become their Mother.

locked_terms.use: Buddhas of the worlds in the ten directions

translation: When a mother with many children gets sick, they all feel sad and take care of her. In the same way, the Buddhas of the worlds in the ten directions keep this holy wisdom in mind. She is their Mother in every world system.
